bench5_note: Class BEH-LED-INDICATOR canonical_payload.bench[5] is id B6, 'dVF/dT red' = -0.002 V/K, tol 4e-4, basis ASSUMPTION (bench file B6_tempco_all.cir, 0-85 C at 20 mA). Supportable from these documents: Kingbright APHHS1005SURCK (p2), AP2012EC (p2) and APT3216SURCK (p2) each state 'Temperature Coefficient of VF TCV ... -1.9 mV/°C, IF = 20mA, -10°C <= T <= 85°C' (Hyper Red / High Efficiency Red), which lies inside -2.0 +/- 0.4 mV/K, so for those red references the basis could become MFR_DATASHEET (value -0.0019 V/K). ASMB-MTB0-0A3A2 Figure 6 (p5, vector) red trace reads -0.0012 V at 24.8 C, -0.0619 V at 49.6 C, -0.1591 V at 100.1 C, i.e. about -2.1 mV/K over 25-100 C (DERIVED, M; drive current not printed on the figure). TLDR4400 and TLHR5200 (the S1 source the class cites for red) give no VF temperature coefficient or VF-vs-temperature curve, so they cannot support B6. VLHW5100/VLMW33 give -4 mV/K but for white, not red. Note also bench[4] (id B5, Iv(1 mA)=1.99 mcd, basis '45*(1/20)^1.0416'): TLDR4400 p2 states 'Luminous intensity IF = 1 mA IV - 2 mcd', which directly supports ~2 mcd.
class_parameter_check: BEH-LED-INDICATOR.parameters: IS default 1.846e-16 A (DERIVED,L), N 2.0 unit 1 (ASSUMPTION,L; unit is the integer 1, not a string), RS 16.4 ohm (DERIVED,L). Definitions/units are consistent with SPICE D-model IS[A], N[-], RS[ohm]. vf_typ default 2.0 V conflicts with TLDR4400 typ 1.8 V (already noted in the OHM-073 recipe limitations); if_max default 0.02 A labelled MFR_DATASHEET while S1 TLDR4400 states 50 mA (Tamb<=60 C). Runtime recipes for OHM-073..081 all bind the shared authored LED_RED (or colour) card via template_override, so any per-part set proposed here needs a per-entry .model to take effect; OHM-082 binds LED_RGB_R / LED_RGB_GB whose N, RS are marked ASSUMPTION in models.inc.
